info.name: TiaMeds Lab Management API
info.description:
Complete REST API collection for TiaMeds Lab Management System. Covers Authentication, Onboarding, Lab Management, Patient Management, Visits, Tests, Reports, Doctors, Insurance, Health Packages, Billing, Sample Association, and Super Admin operations.

Authentication: Cookie-based JWT (HttpOnly cookies). Login flow: POST /auth/login → POST /auth/verify-otp → cookies set automatically.

Base URL: {{baseUrl}}
All protected endpoints require a valid access_token cookie.

item.name: 1. Authentication
Auth / Public

request.description: GET /public/health-check — located in `UserController.java`
POST /public/login — returns AuthResponse with token (see `UserController.java`). After successful login set {{token}} with returned token.
POST /public/register — register a new user (see `UserController.java`).
GET /public/rate-limit-status?username=... — check login rate-limit details (see `UserController.java`).

Refreshes access token using the refresh_token cookie. Both new tokens are set as HttpOnly cookies. No body required.

request.description: Revokes refresh token, increments token version (invalidates all sessions), and clears HttpOnly cookies. Requires authenticated session.

request.description: Initiates password reset flow. Sends reset link to email if account exists. Always returns 200 to prevent user enumeration. Rate limited per email and IP.

query.description: Password reset token from email link

request.description: Validates a password reset token before showing the reset form. Returns token validity and user email.
Resets user password using a valid reset token. Invalidates all existing sessions by incrementing token version. Password must be 8-128 chars and differ from current password.
